resources.string: Export editable OCR text in page order. Original layout is not reconstructed.
Export OCR text to cells. Tabs separate columns and newlines separate rows; review before exporting.
Each page becomes a slide containing its full-resolution scan. Text inside the image is not editable.
Combine pages into a PNG without downsampling. Documents exceeding memory limits report an error.
Draw on the page preview. Undo a stroke or reset. Signature is stored as a separate edit.
Drag a rectangle to erase. Local inpainting fills it from nearby pixels; review before saving.
Experimental removal of colored marks. It may remove colored content too; the original is preserved.
Local contrast and sharpness enhancement. Does not generate detail or reconstruct faces with AI.
Optional cloud tool. Configure a Chat Completions compatible service. Content is sent only when you explicitly press Send; provider fees may apply.
Experimental counting of separated objects on a plain background. Review markers; tap to add or remove one.
Export a password-protected PDF copy. Local scans remain accessible. Forgotten passwords cannot be recovered.
Import up to 500 PDF pages at the chosen resolution. The unchanged original PDF is retained and included in backups.
Capture or import both sides into a two-page document, crop each side, and export together on A4.
Crop to a 35:45 ratio. Does not replace the background or certify official passport-photo requirements.
Capture a book, then use the editor tools to split pages and manually correct curvature.
Scan slides at 16:9, adjust perspective in the editor, and export to a presentation.
Capture a whiteboard with local illumination correction. Review preservation of all writing.
Choose a document and page. You can also scan a new document or import a file.
Operation failed. Check input, file size or service settings and retry.
Choose a document with pages, or scan a new document.
For reordering, include every page exactly once, in the desired order.
Choose documents in the desired order. A new copy is created; originals remain.
Recognize the document text before this export.
Dark objects on a light background
API key (blank keeps the current key)
The visible text is sent to your configured provider. Formula recognition also sends the displayed page image. Review content and results.
No readable code found. Try a closer crop.
Documents, text and edits will be removed from trash. Originals not shared with another document will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
New pages from this capture session will be discarded. Existing document pages will remain.
Continue and save an unfinished scan.
